name: luh-geometric-imperfection-data-for-steel-cylinders
notes: The data set contains measured geometric imperfections of two steel specimen and an industry scale suction bucket in the format of Fourier coefficients. It is linked to the paper "Probabilistic buckling analysis of suction bucket foundations for offshore wind turbines using non-homogeneous random field approaches" (to be submitted)
